answer: Cap Sybil power by network diversity: each provider, network block, or funding cluster may supply only a fixed share of total weight, however many identities it spawns. A thousand agents in one datacenter still count as one small slice, since the cap hits the shared origin, not each name. Real weight requires spreading across independent providers and jurisdictions, paying separate bills each time. As in a sonnet, strict form creates the cost: each new signal of independence must come from a different source, and one opal of genuine diversity outweighs many copies.
